M&A Due Diligence AI Skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive M&A due diligence framework covering financial, operational, technology, legal, cultural, and AI/automation readiness.
- Provides step-by-step assessment with weighted scoring, red flags, deal-breakers, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.
- Includes up-to-date 2026 benchmarks, deal multiples, and integration guidance.
- Features detailed output templates and actionable next-step suggestions.
- Offers links to additional industry-specific resources and calculators for extended analysis.
